props.headline: Thinking about buying a home?
props.body: Whether it's your first home or your next one, we can help you work out what you could afford.

slots.reason: The standard opening we show everyone. Priya already has a mortgage with us, so at Bronze this is still generic.
Priya holds a mortgage with Unicorn, so her screen can show her actual position. Maya and Daniel structurally cannot have this component.
The equity in Priya's home is what makes a move possible, so it sits alongside the mortgage it came from.
The same calculator as everyone else, in its moving mode — it starts from Priya's equity rather than her income.

props.headline: See what moving would cost
props.body: Get an estimate that includes your current mortgage, stamp duty and the fees people forget.

slots.reason: Priya's decision is whether moving is realistic, so the action offered is a costing rather than an application.
Content aimed at someone who already owns, not at someone buying for the first time.

props.headline: Talk it through with an adviser
props.body: Moving with an existing mortgage has more moving parts than a first purchase.

slots.reason: Offered, but not yet prominent — at Bronze the screen doesn't know how complicated Priya's move actually is.
